messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Cyclobenzaprine works by reducing the nerve signals in the brain that drive muscle tone and spasm, which allows tight, overactive muscles to relax. It acts within the central nervous system, primarily at the level of the brain stem, and does not act on the muscles themselves or at the junction between nerves and muscle. 1,2 Because cyclobenzaprine works through the nervous system in this way, it will not relieve muscle spasm caused by central nervous system disease, such as cerebral palsy or spinal cord disease. 1,2
The way cyclobenzaprine works in fibromyalgia is not known. Laboratory studies show it blocks several receptor types, including serotonin (5-HT2A), histamine, and muscarinic receptors. 3
Cyclobenzaprine is chemically related to tricyclic antidepressants such as amitriptyline, which explains several of its side effects (such as drowsiness and dry mouth) and some of its most important drug interactions. 1,2
Triplet: ["Cyclobenzaprine", "acts within", "central nervous system"]

The relation 'acts within' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug exerts its effects within the anatomical or physiological system specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has effect': The subject drug produces the therapeutic or physiological effect specified by the object entity.
B. 'used in': The subject drug is utilized in the medical procedure or clinical context specified by the object entity.
C. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
D. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
E. 'has mechanism of action': The subject drug produces its therapeutic effect through the biological mechanism specified by the object entity.
